[Statistics for the Experimental Bench Biologist: Best practice workflows using R](https://benchbiostats.com){target="_blank"} is guide to implementing better statistical analyses and workflows than commonly employed in the wet bench biological sciences.

[Data From](https://data-from.netlify.app){target="_blank"} is a blog-style site re-analyzing data from the wet-bench biology literature to demonstrate better practices.

[R doodles](https://rdoodles.rbind.io){target="_blank"} is a blog-style site exploring statistical concepts, mostly in ecology, using R.

[Physics for Biologists](files/physics_for_biologists/_book/){target="_blank"} is book containing very short chapter on some specific topics useful when teaching Anatomy & Physiology for Bio majors (or non-majors).

[Numerical Physiology](files/quant-physiology/_book/){target="_blank"} Fun exercises in numerical physiology (none of these require Calculus or above math).
